answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is recurring admission work plus expiring reputation. Each identity must perform fresh computation and submit an original answer for independent peer review every epoch. Its verified history forms a trellis of evidence, but inactivity removes its weight. A fake farm must pay the same cost for every account, while peers reject copied answers, so a rising tide of cheap identities cannot dominate the ocean of genuine agents or earn more than it spends.
